content: OpenCode V1->V2 migration: nix profile opencode 1.18.34 -> 2.2.5 (flake:nixpkgs registry = nixpkgs-unstable 26.11pre; stable channel still ships 1.x). Sessions: V2 does NOT auto-import; V1 DB = opencode-stable.db (channel-stable naming), V2 = opencode.db. Last session migrated (parent ses_e43a8814affeJxOQxiq8z4deUa + 58 children, 1421 msgs) via V1 binary export on isolated XDG_DATA_HOME copy -> python converter (V2 Session.Info needs location:{directory}; assistant messages inline content[] not parts[]; tool content items need time.created) -> POST /api/experimental/session/import (Basic auth user=opencode pass from ~/.config/opencode/service.json; request-level location required else session lands in /home/skem; parents before children). Config: V1 maps -> permissions array / agents / providers (aisdk: prefix + settings.baseURL) / mcp.servers. Plugins ported to Plugin.define+ctx hooks (V1 implementations don't run on V2); local plugin dirs need index.js entrypoint (package.json main ignored); global-config relative plugin paths not resolved -> absolute path. Agent frontmatter: permission->permissions, temperature dropped, subtask->subagent, tools maps -> shell deny rules, bare model aliases (haiku) invalid. cli.json auto-migrated from tui.json. Committed 6264e38; docs/global_setup.md rewritten.

opencode ecosystem updated to V2-native: agents-opencode pack 2.1.1->4.3.5 via nix node24 npx installer (--update --all, target v2 auto). Installer re-ships V1 frontmatter (permission maps/temperature/subtask) -> re-converter needed after EVERY pack update (script /tmp/opencode/migrate_frontmatter.py pattern). Pack plugin now dual-entrypoint .ts+lib/guards.mjs (v2 setup ctx hooks, safeRegister) -> local index.js port deleted, pack .ts adopted (V2 discovery loads loose .ts files fine). caveman upstream updated same day: modes redesigned (lite/full->caveman, ultra->ultracave, wenyan->megacave; LEGACY_MODES map on read; default flag now writes 'caveman'); server.js = v2 entry (ctx.event.subscribe session.created + session.hook prompt/context wrapping v1 hooks); STILL needs index.js shim re-exporting server.js (package.json main ignored by v2) + absolute path in global config. cavecrew agents re-downloaded clean V2 (no tools/model), only name: lines dropped. opencode-rules 2.0.0 verified V2-native (dist: ctx.tool.hook execute.before/after + ctx.session.hook context/prompt + event.subscribe + dispose; TUI part in cli.json). Project committed 786c8f2 pushed.
